title: Visual Large Language Models for Generalized and Specialized Applications

bias_targets.target: Sampling bias (Regional, Socioeconomic, and Cultural bias)
bias_targets.methodology: As a survey paper, it reviews literature on how unrepresentative training data leads to disparities in model performance across different regions, social classes, and cultures, specifically in applications like facial recognition and content generation.

Synthesizing existing studies that highlight demographic disparities and the perpetuation of harmful stereotypes in visual large language models (VLLMs), particularly through analyzing biased outputs in image generation and content interpretation.
